# Vendored libraries

- **three@0.185.0** (MIT, see `LICENSE-three`), from the npm package `build/` folder.
  - `three.module.min.js` imports `./three.core.min.js`, so **both files must stay side by side**.
  - To upgrade: download the same two files from a newer release (check that the minified builds still exist) and update this note.
